theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let D := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let D' := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i + steps, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hmin⟩ : ∃ g ∈ C, d =
      (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard := by
    let S := (fun g : C =>
      (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    obtain ⟨g, -, he⟩ :=
      Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty : S.Nonempty)
    exact ⟨g, g.property, he.symm⟩
  have hb : Code.distFromCode f C ≤ d * 2 ^ steps := by
    apply le_trans (b := (hammingDist f g : ℕ∞))
    · simp only [Code.distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist]
      exact sInf_le ⟨g, hg, le_rfl⟩
    change (Δ₀(f, g) : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [← ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, hmin]
    let X := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g x) Finset.univ
    let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
    change X.card ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    letI : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite Y
    have hs : X ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y.toFinset (fun y =>
        (Set.range (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y))).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, Y, fiberwiseDisagreementSet]
        exact ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2⟩
      · simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_range]
        exact ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
          (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x),
          (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).1 rfl⟩
    refine (Finset.card_le_card hs).trans ?_
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    apply Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul
    intro y _
    simpa only [Set.toFinset_card, Set.image_univ] using
      (card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
        i steps h_i_add_steps y).le
  have heq := (ENat.coe_toNat
    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.coe_ne_top _) hb)).symm
  rw [heq]
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑(Code.distFromCode f C).toNat < ↑D
  rw [← ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (h := by dsimp [D, BBF_CodeDistance]; omega)
  calc
    2 * (Code.distFromCode f C).toNat ≤ 2 * (d * 2 ^ steps) := by
      gcongr
      rw [← ENat.coe_le_coe]
      exact heq ▸ hb
    _ = (2 * d) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ (D' - 1) * 2 ^ steps := by
      gcongr
      exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
    _ = D - 1 := by
      dsimp [D, D', BBF_CodeDistance]
      rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add]
      congr <;> omega
